exercises.why: **заговорил** — заговори́ть (perfective): to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk); to exorcise, to bewitch, to charm, to cast a spell, to enchant. Wiktionary: за- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **заговорил** — заговори́ть (perfective): to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk); to exorcise, to bewitch, to charm, to cast a spell, to enchant. Wiktionary: за- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поеду** — пое́хать (perfective): to ride, to drive; to travel; (figurative) to go mad/insane, to lose one's mind. Wiktionary: по- + е́хать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to knock, to rap, etc.
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: застуча́ть — to begin to knock, to rap, etc.; заговори́ть — to begin to speak; пое́хать — to ride, to drive; поползти́ — to (start) creeping, crawling.
**поеду** — пое́хать (perfective): to ride, to drive; to travel; (figurative) to go mad/insane, to lose one's mind. Wiktionary: по- + е́хать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поплывёт** — поплы́ть (perfective): to start swimming, to start floating; to start sailing; (figuratively) to hesitate or be unsure; (colloquial, slang, figuratively) to lose one's nerve. Wiktionary: по- + плыть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: They began to sail to their home.
exercises.why: **поплыли** — поплы́ть (perfective): to start swimming, to start floating; to start sailing; (figuratively) to hesitate or be unsure; (colloquial, slang, figuratively) to lose one's nerve. Wiktionary: по- + плыть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout
to start running, to break into a run
to begin to want, to begin to desire
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: закрича́ть — to begin to shout, to cry out, to give a shout; засмея́ться — to laugh, to start laughing; побежа́ть — to start running, to break into a run; захоте́ть — to begin to want, to begin to desire.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to start singing, to sing out
to begin to tremble, to begin to shiver
to burst out laughing, to start laughing
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: запла́кать — to start crying, weeping; запе́ть — to start singing, to sing out; задрожа́ть — to begin to tremble, to begin to shiver; рассмея́ться — to burst out laughing, to start laughing.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to start smoking, to light up
(colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: закури́ть — to start smoking, to light up; зарабо́тать — to earn; заигра́ть — to begin to play; расхохота́ться — (colloquial) to burst out laughing, to roar with laughter.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing
to start muttering, to start mumbling
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: загреме́ть — to begin to thunder; заинтересова́ть — to (start to) interest, to concern; зарыда́ть — to begin to sob/blubber, to burst out sobbing; забормота́ть — to start muttering, to start mumbling.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to start swimming, to start floating
to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: потащи́ть — to start pulling; поплы́ть — to start swimming, to start floating; завы́ть — to (begin to) howl, to raise a howl; зашепта́ть — to begin to whisper.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: зашага́ть — to begin to walk; застона́ть — to start moaning; заскрипе́ть — to begin to creak; возненави́деть — to hate, to start hating.
